rationale: Next discriminator replaces the assumed failed-future producer with real InmemTransport pipeline execution. Each isolated scenario constructs a Leader state with expired contact and two Voters; it does not use BootstrapCluster/NewRaft or claim a legal election prefix. Receiver transport admits the request but no receiver Raft or reply producer runs, so no reply can be delivered. Pipeline future Error is awaited independently before real pipelineDecode reads the queued future. Ordinary replicateTo is the comparison path. Main loop, heartbeat, snapshot and verification workers are omitted to isolate the local writer/consumer effect; their absence prevents inference of cluster role duration. Raw marker times, completion/error, stable operation label and request identity are observed before a manual lease invocation. No application consequence, normative violation or property Evidence is claimed. Exploration finishes on actual future/decoder completion with bounded tool timeouts, not on a desired state.
